A diagram of the user inputs (i.e., the **Predict** button), reactives, and the API request/response is below:

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {'theme': 'neutral', 'look': 'handDrawn', 'themeVariables': { 'fontFamily': 'monospace'}}}%%

graph LR
	subgraph RApi["R Shiny App"]
	A1["Shiny R Code"] --> A2["<code>vals()</code><br/>Reactive data"]
	A2 --> B1["<code>httr2</code><br>package"]
	B1 --> C1["<code>request(api_url)</code><br/>Creates request object"]
	C1 --> D1["<code>req_method('POST')</code><br/>Sets HTTP verb"]
	C1 --> G1["<code>req_body_json(request_data)</code><br/>Penguin features payload"]
	D1 --> H0["<code>req_perform()</code><br><strong>Executes HTTP request</strong>"]
	G1 --> H0
	H0 --> H1["HTTP POST Request"]
	H1 --> I1["<strong>Vetiver API Server<br><code>localhost:8080/predict</code></strong>"]
	I1 --> J1["HTTP Response"]
	J1 --> M1["<code>resp_body_json()</code><br><strong>Parses JSON response</strong>"]
	M1 --> N1["<code>response$.pred[1]</code><br><strong>Extract prediction</strong>"]
	N1 --> O1["Return to Shiny<br>Display in UI"]
end

style B1 fill:#e1f5fe
style I1 fill:#e8f5e8,color:#000
style H0 fill:#ff9800,color:#000
style M1 fill:#9c27b0,color:#fff
style N1 fill:#4caf50,color:#fff
```
